description: This file defines a React context provider component for managing data table state, including filters, sorting, pagination, segments, and other UI controls. It exports context types, a context object, and a provider component that composes multiple context providers and a context bridge for state management.

methods.name: DataTableContextBridge
methods.description: A React component that creates a combined context value from various hooks and provides it via DataTableContext.Provider.

methods.name: DataTableProvider
methods.description: A React component that wraps children with multiple context providers for data table state, including segment, filter, and main state providers.
